description: Get the current token of an active delegation by its public ph_dlg_* handle — after a signing-key rotation, the re-signed token to publish in place of the old one. Public endpoint — no API key required, since the token is already published with the delegation. Any handle that is not an active delegation (revoked, suspended, expired or unknown) answers the same not_found.
name: get_delegation_token

outputSchema.description: The current token of an active delegation

token.description: The delegation token as stored now — the one to publish in place of an older copy
